title: Web Endpoints, Ingress & Reverse Proxies
steps: Inspect Zabbix host tags: service, ingress, depends_on, app_host, and tier.
Check ingress/reverse-proxy traces in SigNoz (when traces-only, skip log queries for that ingress service).
Separate edge/ingress failures from upstream backend errors on app_host.
If >=3 endpoints sharing the same service tag fail together, inspect app_host first.
avoid: Do NOT search logs for traces-only ingress proxies listed in the SigNoz catalog.
Do NOT infer a shared root cause across unrelated endpoints lacking a common service/app_host tag.
